title: PIMS MTI Ordinance strike and protest campaign, begun in November 2020
notes: The Pakistan 2021-01 continuation PAK202101-C001 documents a Nov. 30 start and a 72-day strike; its cited sources remain in that unit. The February Dawn report PAK-S124 separately mentions PIMS employees’ strike/call-off context and does not treat it as part of the Feb. 10 federal pay protest. A return-to-work announcement does not by itself establish the physical end of any gathering. Preserve this as earlier campaign context, not a February-start candidate or a pooled crowd.
